notes: Prices include taxes and are what a residential customer pays (see each entry for exceptions).

Electricity "allIn" is the average price of a 1,000 kWh/month bill including fixed charges; "allInCurrentTariff" rebuilds that bill from tariffs in effect on 2026-10-08. "variable" is the price of one more kWh in the tier an electrically heated home reaches in winter.
Natural gas "allIn" spreads fixed charges over 2,400 m³ a year (2,200 m³ in Ontario's former Union zones); "variable" excludes fixed charges.
The federal consumer carbon charge has been zero since April 1, 2025 and BC's consumer carbon tax ended the same day; Quebec's cap-and-trade charge still applies to natural gas.
Heating oil: Statistics Canada table 18-10-0001-01 (August 2026 and the 12-month average, September 2025 to August 2026). Oil prices rose sharply in 2026.
Firewood and wood pellets: no 2025–2026 price source could be verified; enter your supplier's price.

Ontario natural gas prices are for Enbridge's EGD rate zone (Toronto, Ottawa, Niagara). Homes in the former Union Gas zones, and Kitchener Utilities or Utilities Kingston customers, pay different rates.

electricity.utility: Toronto Hydro (provincial default; Ottawa override uses Hydro Ottawa)
electricity.basis: allIn: Hydro-Québec 2025 comparison, Toronto residential bill at 1,000 kWh/month incl. taxes (17.90 c/kWh; 15.57 c/kWh before tax). HQ's 'excluding taxes' Ontario bills already net the Ontario Electricity Rebate (13.1% on 2025-04-01); HST 13% is charged on the pre-rebate subtotal. Rates and the rebate have changed since (see allInCurrentTariff).
electricity.variableBasis: Marginal cost of one kWh for a Toronto Hydro customer on default time-of-use pricing: TOU average 12.75 c x loss factor 1.0295 + volumetric delivery 2.401 c (transmission and riders) + regulatory 0.53 c = 16.06 c before rebate/tax, x 0.895 (OER 23.5%, HST 13%). Toronto Hydro's residential distribution charge is a fixed service charge, so it does not affect the marginal price.
electricity.sourceDate: Rates in effect 2025-04-01 (Hydro-Québec, Comparison of Electricity Prices in Major North American Cities 2025, published October 2025; no 2026 edition was online on 2026-10-08)
electricity.variableDate: RPP prices effective 2025-11-01 (next reset 2026-11-01); Toronto Hydro delivery rates effective 2026-01-01
electricity.allInCurrentTariffBasis: Same 1,000 kWh/30-day bill rebuilt from tariffs in effect 2026-10-08: RPP time-of-use average 12.75 c/kWh (OEB weights 64% off-peak 9.8 c, 18% mid-peak 15.7 c, 18% on-peak 20.3 c; Nov 1, 2025 prices) x Toronto Hydro loss factor 1.0295; Toronto Hydro 2026 fixed charges $49.11/30 days (service charge $51.18, riders, SME, SSS admin); volumetric riders 0.160 c and transmission 2.241 c/kWh; regulatory 0.53 c/kWh; then Ontario Electricity Rebate 23.5% (since Nov 1, 2025) and HST 13% on the pre-rebate subtotal (net factor 0.895).
electricity.tiers: Tiered plan (optional): 12.0 c/kWh up to 1,000 kWh/month in winter (Nov-Apr; 600 kWh in May-Oct), 14.2 c/kWh above; an electrically heated home above the winter threshold pays about $0.157/kWh all-in at the margin. Ultra-low overnight plan: 3.9 c/kWh 11 p.m.-7 a.m. (about $0.062/kWh all-in), 39.1 c/kWh on-peak 4-9 p.m. weekdays.

gas.utility: Enbridge Gas Inc. - Enbridge Gas Distribution (EGD) rate zone, system gas (Rate 1; Toronto, Ottawa, Niagara per Enbridge)
gas.basis: OEB backgrounder for the Oct 1, 2026 QRAM gives a total annual bill of $999.95 for a typical EGD-zone customer using 2,400 m3 (it reconciles with the published rate components only before HST, so it is treated as pre-tax); that figure includes a one-time credit (rate adjustment of -0.6494 c/m3, -$15.59/yr) which is removed here, giving $1,015.54 before tax; x 1.13 HST / 2,400 m3. Variable = gas supply 9.4741 + cost adjustment 0.5322 + delivery 12.2850 (block over 170 m3/month, typical of winter heating months) + transportation to Enbridge 5.4818 c/m3, x 1.13. Federal carbon charge 0 since Apr 1, 2025.
gas.sourceDate: Rates effective 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31 (OEB interim order EB-2026-0221, Sept 24, 2026)
gas.taxNote: HST 13% applied at the standard Ontario rate; no fetched source states the gas tax treatment explicitly.

UnionSouth.basis: OEB annual bill $934.80 at 2,200 m3 less one-time $14.68 charge (billed Oct-Dec 2026); variable = commodity 15.3548 + gas price adjustment 2.3461 + delivery 7.4325 (over 250 m3/month) c/m3; transportation is included in the commodity in this zone.

UnionNorthEast.basis: OEB annual bill $1,159.01 at 2,200 m3 plus one-time credit $12.22 removed; variable = commodity 15.6674 + adjustment 2.1088 + transportation 1.7135 - 0.5546 + delivery 17.9146 (301-500 m3/month block) c/m3.

UnionNorthWest.basis: OEB annual bill $857.98 at 2,200 m3 plus one-time credit $19.90 removed; variable = commodity 9.5866 - 2.6700 + transportation 2.7031 - 0.5594 + delivery 14.4542 (301-500 m3/month block) c/m3.

zones.note: Which Ontario cities fall in each Union zone was not verified from a fetched source, so no city overrides were made for gas; Enbridge's rate page names Toronto, Ottawa and Niagara as Rate 1 (EGD) areas.

electricity.sourceDate: Rates in effect 2025-04-01 (Hydro-Québec, Comparison of Electricity Prices in Major North American Cities 2025, published October 2025; no 2026 edition was online on 2026-10-08); SL&P rates effective 2026-02-01

electricity.basis: Not in the Hydro-Québec comparison. FortisBC electric tariff RS 1 effective Jan 1, 2026 (BCUC G-293-25): 15.503 c/kWh for all kWh + customer charge $49.58 per two months ($24.79/month); 1,000 kWh/month x 1.05 GST.
